stat.title: Tests
stat.subTitle: This Month
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(count(r.id), 0) as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where YEAR(r.endedOn) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) and MONTH(r.endedOn) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)
stat.sqlForExtra: select ifnull(concat(round(ifnull(sum(case when r.resultCategory1 not in (5,6,7) then 1 else 0 end), 0)/ifnull(count(r.id), 1)*100),'%'), '0%') as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where YEAR(r.endedOn) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) and MONTH(r.endedOn) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)

stat.title: MTB+ Rate
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(concat(round(sum(case when f.resultCategory1 in (1,2) then f.resultCount else 0 end)/sum(case when f.resultCategory1 not in (5,6,7) then f.resultCount else 0 end)*100),'%'), '0%') as cnt from FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.assayId in (1,2) and f.days = 30
stat.sqlForStatUnit: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where  f.assayId in (1,2) and resultCategory1 not in (5,6,7) and f.days = 30

stat.title: RR Rate
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT ifnull(concat(round(sum(CASE WHEN f.resultCategory2=1 AND f.resultCategory1 = 1 THEN f.resultCount ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN f.resultCategory1 = 1 THEN f.resultCount ELSE 0 END) * 100, 0), '%'), '0%') AS cnt FROM FactResultsDeviceByCategory1And2 AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON s.partnerId = p.id LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE f.assayId IN (1,2) AND f.days = 30
stat.sqlForStatUnit: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.resultCategory1=1 and f.assayId in (1,2) and f.days = 30

stat.title: TI Rate
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT ifnull(concat(round(sum(CASE WHEN f.resultCategory2=4 AND f.resultCategory1 = 1 THEN f.resultCount ELSE 0 END)/sum(CASE WHEN f.resultCategory1 = 1 THEN f.resultCount ELSE 0 END) * 100, 0), '%'), '0%') AS cnt FROM FactResultsDeviceByCategory1And2 AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON s.partnerId = p.id LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE f.assayId IN (1,2) AND f.days = 30
stat.sqlForStatUnit: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDeviceByCategory1 as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.resultCategory1=1 and f.assayId in (1,2) and f.days = 30

target.title: Total Tests
target.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(count(r.id), 0) as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id inner join Assay as a on a.id = r.assayId

target.title: MDR-TB
target.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(count(r.id), 0) as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id inner join Assay as a on a.id = r.assayId where (ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.previouslyTreated"), '') = '"Yes"' or ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.previouslyTreated"), '') = 'true') and ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.hivStatus"), '') != '"HIV Positive"' and ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.microscopyResult"), '') not like '%Positive"' and cast(ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.age"), 100) as UNSIGNED) >= 18 and r.assayId in (1,2)
target.sqlForDataCollection: select concat(round(sum(case when replace(ifnull(JSON_EXTRACT(patientData, "$.previouslyTreated"), ''), '"', '') != '' then 1 else 0 end)/count(r.id)*100,0),'%') as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where r.assayId in (1,2)
